description_expanded:
This newly added home features a location convenient to the Caliza Pool complex, ZUMA Wellness Center, and the emerging Town Center. The private courtyard features an inviting private pool, outdoor dining area, gas grill as well as covered seating and an outdoor TV to enjoy. The first floor offers an open-plan great room with gas fireplace, dining area and kitchen with a large center island. Also, conveniently found on the first floor is a king bedroom with an ensuite bathroom and a private patio with seating. As you ascend to the second floor, you will find a bunk room with two sets of bunk beds at the top of the stairs. This room shares a bathroom with a queen bedroom on this level. The additional queen bedroom offers an ensuite bathroom. Lastly, you will find the spacious primary suite with a king-sized bed offering a walk-in shower and deep soaking bathtub. Parking for this home is located in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 94 Nonesuch Way. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
